Numbers here = 36 group matches (Arts. 9.2-9.3) + R16 index: 1D=R16-2->38, 1B=R16-3->39, 1C=R16-5->41, 1A=R16-7->43. Task 6 MUST reconcile against the official Match Schedule PDF and renumber table+_meta together (then re-run scripts/verify_thirds_table.py) if the schedule assigns different numbers.
